WHY THIS ROW EXISTS. task-eb6a1fa6 closed the spoofing paths at the policy.validate WRITER - a caller can no longer supply the slice chain, the waivers or the actor - and made the durable PolicyEvaluated row auditable. It could NOT make a policy decision AUTHORITATIVE, because the decision is still computed from caller-supplied facts and no server-held fact source exists to compute it from instead. Branch 2 was ruled for exactly that reason: ruling for branch 1 would have been ruling for a producer nobody has.

THE MEASUREMENT, symbol by symbol, at HEAD 3537be6:
1. NO DURABLE POLICY FACT PRODUCER.
   git grep -rn "inputFacts" -- apps/daemon/src ':!*.test.ts' ':!*fixtures*'   -> EXIT 1, ZERO lines.
   The only non-test `facts:` sites are demo-seed-payloads.ts:129 (the demo seed, caller-shaped) and identity/session-authority.ts:121 `const facts: Facts = { ...principal }`, which is SESSION/principal facts - a different concept entirely.
2. NO DURABLE WAIVER PRODUCER.
   git grep -rn "PolicyWaiver|humanApprovalRef|waiverRef|waivers" -- apps/daemon/src ':!*.test.ts' ':!*fixtures*'
   -> ONE line, demo-seed-payloads.ts:144 `waivers: []`, a demo literal.
   Design 699 (packages/core/src/policy/policy-contract.ts:102-108) defines a waiver as "the only legal relaxation - scoped, expiring, human-approved, SOFT-only" with a required `humanApprovalRef`. No record exists for that ref to point at.
3. THE DECISION IS CALLER-DERIVED BY CONSTRUCTION. evaluatePolicy derives the outcome from `input.facts` (policy-evaluation.ts:172-182) and passes `input.decisionDigest` straight back at :190. A server digest over the installed slices, principal, ref and action - which eb6a1fa6 added - authenticates BYTES; it does not create AUTHORITY over a decision computed from caller facts.

THE LIVE COST, and it is a shipped regression rather than a hypothetical. journey-authority-bodies.ts:132 sets `admissionGatePolicy: "POLICY_ALLOWANCE"` on a PRODUCTION path. Under branch 2 the admission gate fails closed on every caller-derived row, so POLICY_ALLOWANCE nodes stop being admitted until this row lands. That was ruled knowingly: a capability that only worked because its gate could be forged was not working. But it stays broken until a server-held source exists, which is what makes this CRITICAL rather than a cleanup.

DELIVERABLE. A durable, server-held source of policy evaluation facts - and of waivers, human-approved per design 699 - that `policy.validate` reads INSTEAD of taking `input.facts` from the caller, so the resulting decision can be stamped as server-verified and the admission gate can admit it. The three-way outcome vocabulary eb6a1fa6 installs at the gate already has the slot: today every row stamps CALLER_ATTRIBUTED and refuses; this row makes SERVER_VERIFIED reachable and turns eb6a1fa6's gated todo arm into a real executing test.

NOT IN SCOPE: the policy language itself; who may call policy.validate; and the budget half of task-1de7b81a, which is budgetHash-only under comment-f702f663.

WHEN THIS IS DONE, the branch 2 ruling is REVISITABLE rather than permanent - that is condition 2's stated purpose. Whoever plans it should re-read comment-fcbd1ba7 and comment-a5f67af4 on task-eb6a1fa6 first: QA's constructibility test in particular ("could a caller assemble a record indistinguishable from a verified one? if yes, the distinguishing field is decoration") is the trap this row must not fall into.

CONSUMER: task-eb6a1fa6's gated SERVER_VERIFIED arm, and transitively every POLICY_ALLOWANCE node on the shipped journey.
taskRails: The fact source must be SERVER-HELD and durable. A caller-supplied value that is merely persisted is not a durable fact - that is the exact defect task-eb6a1fa6 was filed for, and re-introducing it one layer down is a rejection.

Waivers are human-approved per design 699 (policy-contract.ts:102-108): scoped, expiring, SOFT-only, with a humanApprovalRef that points at a real record. A waiver producer with no human approval behind it does not discharge this row.

Apply QA's constructibility test before claiming a field distinguishes verified from caller-derived: if a caller could assemble a record indistinguishable from a verified one, the field is decoration and no drill can reveal it.

Do not weaken the admission gate task-eb6a1fa6 installs in order to make a journey pass. Fail-closed is the ruled direction; this row earns admission by producing authority, never by relaxing the check.
Fail closed with exact code+layer, upstream code+layer preserved unrestamped; missing or unverifiable stays UNKNOWN; TDD; <=250 lines per production source; explicit-pathspec commits.
